cueCard.topic: Describe a crowded place you have been to.
cueCard.explain: and explain how you felt about being in this place.

questions.text: Describe a crowded place you have been to.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a crowded place you have been to. You should say: where it was; when you went there; why it was so crowded; and explain how you felt about being in this place.

questions.text: Would you go back to this place at a busy time?
questions.say: Thank you. Would you go back to this place at a busy time?

questions.text: Why do some people enjoy being in crowded places?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a crowded place you have been to, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all crowds. Why do some people enjoy being in crowded places?

questions.text: What can be done to make crowded places such as stations safer?

questions.text: Are cities in your country more crowded than they were twenty years ago?

questions.text: What problems can a fast-growing population cause in a city?

questions.text: Why do many young people move from villages to big cities?
